Original tube/beam normals and dark ambient remain; no whole-source promotion onto those other models.

data/strazni_vez_strecha_.pac.sourceAssessment: Dedicated coarse peeling/weathered olive finish on modeled roof, frame and platform components, 17.600m2 near / 332 alternative triangles. o/misc/lsni_tce.pac.sourceAssessment: Three original rust/coating tube strips with bright/dark photographed relief rows. Full original tube/brace fans sample those strips with repeated U; no invented rust/metal/shadow mask. Modeled supports/braces cover 13.967m2 near on leseni2x and 22.600m2 on leseni4x. Exact original model/fingerprint/bindings and pixels are required; original ambient retained by rough PBR/reflector-only treatment. Deck planks, ladder and clamps use separate IsTransparent sections and keep their render-behavior gates, even where decoded alpha is opaque. Last visual LOD has no ordinary tube source, so there is no far-LOD promotion.
o/misc/lsni_tce.pac.outcome: built and appearance-tested exact-model rough PBR/reflector-only coating; original ambient and transparent sibling surfaces retained
